text:
Maria Chen: dropping a variant that snaps the time-range handle to 5% increments and collapses the density pill into the p95 header. mock: https://redwood.design/mock/2165004322.png. goal: reduce accidental micro-drags and keep p95 card height stable. quick skim for accessibility/copy/impl risks?

Ben Ortiz: nice. curious about the snap friction 1 vs 5% — does it feel too coarse on narrow ranges? can we offer modifier keys for fine-grain?

Maria Chen: thinking: drag = 5% snap, Shift+drag = 1% steps, click to enter numeric mode. Mobile long-press opens a mini-input.

Elaine Park: accessibility: ensure knob has 44px hit area even if visually smaller. add `aria-valuetext` like "Sampling density, 60 percent" and `role=slider`. Also copy tweak: prefer "Sampling density" (noun) over "Sampling". helper copy: "Higher density improves p95 accuracy but increases compute."

Noah Kim: small perf note: when density changes we re-run aggregation; if users scrub quickly it's a lot of short-lived queries. Suggest client-side previews for visuals only, server commit on release with 750ms debounce. Also add debounce on server to coalesce from same session (1s).

Sunil Rao: agreed. we'll implement a gateway coalescer and emit `telemetry.sampling.update` with `delta` and `final=true` on commit. Also we'll return a 202 while previewing and 200 on commit. If commit rate > 6/sec we'll return 429 with `Retry-After`.

Ben Ortiz: UX note: when snapping, animate the handle to avoid jumpiness. charts: crossfade heatmap buckets and hold y-axis max for 800ms while data streams in. prevents perceived volatility.

Ava (design-bot): visual-lint: handle contrast 3.1:1 (fail). recommended >=4.5 for body. Accessible name suggestion: `aria-label=\"Sampling density slider\"`. Add `aria-live=\"polite\"` region for announcements.

Elaine Park: keyboard behavior: ArrowLeft/Right = 1%, Shift+Arrow = 5%, Home/End = min/max. For assistive tech announce: "Sampling density set to 40 percent (default)". Focus ring: 3px solid token `focus-600` + 6px touch halo on mobile.

Maria Chen: copy decisions: label = "Sampling density"; helper tooltip = "Percentage of requests used to compute latency aggregates. Increase for accuracy, decrease to save compute." low-density banner when <15%: "Low sampling may hide rare high-latency events." approved?

Noah Kim: approved. will add server-side quick-aggregate path for commits so the UI can surface an interim p95 while full aggregation finishes. returns `approximate=true` flag.

Ben Ortiz: I'll implement: 1) snap to 5% on drag, Shift for 1%; 2) numeric entry modal on click; 3) animate handle; 4) aria attributes + live region; 5) unit + e2e tests ensuring no layout shift in p95 card.

Sunil Rao: infra tasks: gateway coalesce 1s, throttle >6/s, metric `gateway.sampling.commit.rate`, and endpoint returns quick-agg with `approximate` until final commit is ready.

Ava (design-bot): change log entry created: https://changelog.redwood/2165004322. accessibility checklist flagged and assigned to Elaine.

Maria Chen: awesome. can someone mock the numeric entry microcopy? small modal: label "Sampling density (%)", input with step 1, Cancel/Apply, helper text same as tooltip. we'll review in Thursday design sync. :sparkles:
